```python
from cyhole.birdeye import Birdeye

# Instantiate Birdeye with default Solana chain
# API key will be loaded from BIRDEYE_API_KEY environment variable
birdeye = Birdeye()

# Solana token address (example: SOL)
token_address = "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"

# Fetch current price synchronously
price_response = birdeye.client.get_price(address=token_address)

# Display the price data
print(f"Price Response: {price_response}")
print(f"Data: {price_response.data}")
```
